import argparse,importlib.util,json,statistics,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from validation_support import command,clean_environment,save_json,sha
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('lb',root/'scripts/logue-bench.py');lb=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(lb)
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--variants',default='baseline,candidate,candidate,baseline');p.add_argument('--output',required=True);a=p.parse_args()
base=Path('/tmp/birnam-selector-investigation')
prefixes={'baseline':Path('/tmp/birnam-selector-investigation/combined-prefix'),'candidate':Path('/tmp/birnam-fixed-digests/candidate-prefix')}
logue=Path('/tmp/birnam-logue-logfix/acceptance/logue')
project=Path('/tmp/birnam-number-bound/acceptance/examples/log-summary/bench')
data=Path('/tmp/birnam-number-bound/acceptance/data')
expect=json.loads((data/'small.expected.json').read_text())
cfg=dict(phase='arena',seed=12345,width=16,monsters=8,turns=16,batches=4,samples=3,allocation=False,replace=False)
(logue/'hash-probe.birnam').write_text('[Globals at: #LogueBenchConfig put: '+lb.literal(cfg)+'];\n[System load: "logue-bench.birnam"]')
runs=[]
for variant in a.variants.split(','):
 binary=prefixes[variant]/'bin/birnam'
 for app in ['logue','json']:
  args=[binary,'hash-probe.birnam'] if app=='logue' else [binary,'run',project,'--',data/'small.jsonl','3']
  r=command(args,cwd=logue if app=='logue' else root,env=clean_environment(),timeout=150)
  assert r['exit_code']==0 and not r['stderr'],r
  if app=='logue':
   lines=r['stdout'].splitlines();assert lines[0]=='[logue-core] loaded'
   report=json.loads(lines[1]);lb.check_report(report,cfg)
   samples=[b['cpu_ns'] for sample in report['results'] for b in sample]
  else:
   report=json.loads(r['stdout']);assert report['report']==expect
   samples=[b['cpu_ns'] for b in report['samples']]
  row=dict(variant=variant,app=app,samples=samples,median_ns=statistics.median(samples),checked=True)
  runs.append(row);print(variant,app,round(row['median_ns']/1e6,3),flush=True)
  save_json(a.output,dict(runs=runs,driver=Path(__file__).read_text()))
